remarks: Experience the best of Darien living in this exceptional luxury property, thoughtfully designed for both elegant entertaining and comfortable everyday living. Set on a beautifully landscaped one-acre property, this impressive Colonial offers over 5,100 square feet of refined living space, combining timeless craftsmanship with modern amenities.  The heart of the home is a beautifully appointed chef's kitchen featuring marble countertops, premium appliances, an oversized center island, and a sunny breakfast area that opens seamlessly to the inviting family room with a fireplace. Formal living and dining rooms, rich architectural details, and abundant natural light create warm, sophisticated spaces throughout.  The expansive primary suite serves as a private retreat with spa-inspired baths and generous walk-in closet, while four additional bedrooms provide ample space for family, guests, or a home office. A finished lower level offers flexible living space ideal for recreation, playroom, fitness, or remote work.  Outdoor living is equally inviting, with a spacious deck overlooking the private backyard and mature landscaping-perfect for relaxing evenings or entertaining. A three-car attached garage and whole-house generator add everyday convenience.  Ideally located just minutes from Darien's award-winning schools, Cherry Lawn Park, downtown, Metro-North, and area beaches, this exceptional residence offers the perfect balance of luxury, comfort and convenience.
